comments.comment:
This failure has been occurring since the landings on May 11th, 2026. As of today, Maloo reports a 23.61% failure rate. 

Patch https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/64294 introduced sanity-quota/test_98. ckansal , can you please take a look?

+1 on master: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/618f2fe4-3766-492c-ab59-9df3aea0c4a2

This is failing about 22% of the time with 4 MDTs, so it may just be randomly picking the same start MDT that just returned -EDQUOT?

"Chakshu Kansal <ckansal@ddn.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/65948
Subject: LU-20249 lmv: improve quota-aware MDT retry testing
Project: fs/lustre-release
Branch: master
Current Patch Set: 1
Commit: 26a7480861e47158d325fab66f563577e1d3be99

+119 failures in the past week.

ckansal, I see your patch is ready for review, but it is on you (and all developers) to seek out reviews for your patch. A friendly ping once per week on a patch (sorted in priority) is useful to keep it moving forward. Patches like this that fix intermittent failures should have a high priority since this affects all developers. Doubly so for failures in sanity.sh since this runs 10x for every patch in different configurations, so even a 1% subtest failure has a 10% chance of affecting every version of every patch.
+130 failures in the past week. Hopefully the fix will get into master-next and land soon...
